facts.fact: 城破后花了整整一个月修补 Faoldun 城与城堡，这期间 Tilde 尽量不去想 Guwetha
facts.anchor: the month it took to bring Faoldun city and its keep back into repair

facts.fact: 自称 Ladbh 的女人早已进了森林，Tilde 预感将来还会再听到她的消息
facts.anchor: Ladbh was long gone into the forest

facts.fact: Alar 送诗、送书、送「翼」的训词来接近她，Tilde 认定自己是他棋盘上一枚被挪动的子
facts.anchor: a piece he was moving into place

facts.fact: Tilde 与 Elise 互相吸引，且都知道这份吸引最终会把彼此烧掉
facts.anchor: We were drawn together like moths to a light

facts.fact: 大厅门上原雕结绳群狼的 Sanafin 家徽被磨平刮净，改刻成天鹅以配合新朝
facts.anchor: had been sanded and scraped to look more like swans

facts.fact: 宴席上两头烤猪的眼窝里塞了黑布丁，顺着脸颊淌成黑色的眼泪
facts.anchor: Black pudding had been set in the sockets of their eyes

facts.fact: 她向 Elise 微笑，Elise 没有回笑，目光只移向长兄
她盯着酒杯与母亲的戒指，才想起自己没验过酒里有没有毒
facts.anchor: I had not tested it for poison
